GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 486.8 (14 Dec 45) CE
(SCAPIN - 446)
14 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Reproduction of Smooth Sheets.
1. It is desired that the Japanese Hydrographic Department prepare to two (2) copies of all their original compilation smooth sheets, plus one (1) additional copy of the sheets within the areas of Alaska, Hawaiian Islands, and Philippine Islands.
2. It is desired that the copies be divided and bound into three (3) groups; namely, two (2) complete sets, plus a partial set including only Alaska, Hawaiian Islands, and Philippine Islands. It is desired that all copies be submitted to this headquarters on or before 1 February, 1946.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
